payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear description of how crowd workers were instructed to identify important elements in document collections using a novel crowdsourcing scheme.

claims.text: Crowd workers were instructed to use a low-context importance annotation scheme, which allows them to determine important elements without reading all documents.
Workers were provided with a description of the document cluster's topic and propositions, enabling them to score the importance of propositions without needing to read the documents.
The task involved collecting Likert-scores from multiple workers for each proposition to rank their importance based on average scores.
